blocks.text: X-ray crystallography 1912 mein William Henry Bragg aur William Lawrence Bragg ne banai, jinhen is kaam par 1915 ka Physics ka Nobel inaam mila. Tab se yeh minerals, namak (salts), dhaaton (metals), proteins, carbohydrates, nucleic acids aur vitamins samet mukhtalif maddon ke tajziye (analysis) ke liye istemal hoti hai. Is technique mein X-ray ka beam ek crystal se takrata hai, aur crystal ke atoms aur molecules beam ko khaas simton mein diffract karte hain. Diffract hue beams ke zaviyon (angles) aur shiddat (intensities) se crystal ke andar electron density ki 3D tasveer banti hai, aur electron density se molecule ki 3D banawat banai jati hai.
Protein ki banawat kaise maloom hoti hai

items: Protein crystallisation: khalis (purified) protein ko thos crystal shakal mein badla jata hai. Crystals is liye chahiye ke woh protein ke molecules ko ek ba-qaida dohrai hui tarteeb mein rakhte hain, jo X-ray amal mein saaf tasveer lene ke liye aham hai. Scientists protein ko aahista khaas mahlool (solutions) se milate hain jo molecules ko tarteeb se chipka dete hain; is mein ghante, din ya hafte lag sakte hain aur aksar darja-hararat (temperature), pH aur namak ki concentration par mohtat qaboo chahiye hota hai. Saaf, mustahkam crystal ban jaye to woh agle qadmon mein istemal hota hai.

Diffraction pattern ka banna: achhe mayar ka crystal X-ray machine mein lagaya jata hai aur X-ray beam mukhtalif zaviyon se us par mara jata hai. Crystal ke atoms beam ko diffract karte hain aur detectors par ek diffraction pattern, nuqton (spots) ka silsila, banta hai.
Density map banana: in nuqton ke zaviye aur shiddat crystal mein atoms ki tarteeb ki maloomat rakhte hain, aur diffraction pattern se density map banaya jata hai.
Protein ki banawat ka taayyun: data ka riyazi (mathematical) tajziya computational programs se kiya jata hai, jin ke hisaab data ko protein ki 3D banawat mein badalte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen se X-rays aa kar ek jamni crystal par parti hain; mura hua teer batata hai ke crystal ghoomta hai. Bikhri (diffracted) shuaein ek lambe X-ray detector par jati hain. Teer Computer + Graphics ke dabbe tak, phir neeche Electron Density Map (zanjeer ke gird neela jaal) tak, aur baen Protein Model tak jata hai jo helices aur strands wale ribbon se bana hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer ke saath chalein: crystal ko ghuma kar har rukh se X-rays dali jati hain; crystal ke atoms unhen mukhtalif zawiyon par bikher dete hain aur detector un ka namoona (pattern) record karta hai. Computer is pattern se electron density map banata hai, jis mein atoms ki jagah dikhti hai, aur us map par protein ka model bithaya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Mahlool mein protein ko seedha X-ray beam mein kyun nahin rakha ja sakta, aur crystallographer ko sab se pehle kya karna hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Mahlool mein molecules be-tarteeb hote hain aur X-rays ko dhundle bikhrao mein bikher dete hain; sirf crystal, jahan molecules ba-qaida tarteeb mein dohrate hain, tez diffraction nuqte deta hai. Is liye pehla qadam khalis protein ka crystal ugana hai, jis mein qaboo-shuda darja-hararat, pH aur namak ki concentration par ghanton se hafton tak lag sakte hain.

items: X-ray crystallography (Braggs, 1912; Nobel inaam 1915) minerals, namak, dhaaton, proteins, carbohydrates, nucleic acids aur vitamins ki 3D banawat maloom karti hai.
Qadam: protein ko crystal banao; bohat se zaviyon par nuqton ka diffraction pattern lo; zaviyon aur shiddat se electron density map banao; 3D banawat compute karo.
